name: Ginger Cookies with Caramel Frosting
subtitle: From Ingrid
notes: This recipe was shared by Ingrid, from the Spokane 7-mile ward, and passed along by Marta in December 2022.

steps.title: Cream the butter and sugars
steps.body: Cream together **1½ cups butter**, **¾ cup sugar**, **1 cup brown sugar**, **2 eggs**, **½ cup molasses** and **2 tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.body: Add and mix well: **4½ cups flour**, **1 Tbsp ginger**, **2 tsp baking soda**, **2 tsp cinnamon**, **½ tsp salt** and **½ tsp ground cloves**.

steps.title: Bake the cookies
steps.body: Drop teaspoon portions of dough on ungreased cookie sheets and bake for 8–10 minutes at 325°F. (They're better soft, so err on the side of under-baking.)

steps.title: Start the frosting
steps.body: For the frosting, add to a small-medium saucepan: **1 cup brown sugar** and **4 Tbsp butter**. Bring to a boil, then stir constantly for 1 minute.

steps.title: Add the milk
steps.body: Then add **¼ cup milk**. Bring the mixture to a boil again and remove from heat.

steps.title: Finish the frosting
steps.body: Let cool for 3 minutes, then add **1 tsp vanilla**, a dash of salt and **1½ cups powdered sugar**. Mix and frost cookies immediately, since this frosting cools and hardens rapidly.
